newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU sets cEreal product refunds for January 1.
newsitem.headline: EU sets cEreal product refunds for January 1.

text.p: The European Union's cereals management committee on Thursday fixed annual export refunds for processed products, compound feed and non-annex II products from January 1, an EU offcial said on Friday.
"The cereals and rice management committee set refunds for processed products for January because there will be no meeting before that date," the official said.
The committee set the following refunds (in European currency units per tonne)-
processed and non-annex II only barley 31.76
processed and non-annex II only broken rice 33.06
processed and non-annex II only round rice 250.00
processed and non-annex II only long grain 250.00
processed and non-annex II only potato starch 45.09
processed, non-annex II only glucose, products 36.97
